concern_summary: This concern involves determining the appropriate cursor style for different states of UI components, influencing the visual feedback provided to users based on interaction capabilities and accessibility.

This concern manages the cursor position during text input, ensuring it reflects the correct location after text changes, including modifications involving emojis. It encompasses functionalities that update, retrieve, and accurately place the cursor in response to user typing actions.

This concern deals with calculating cursor coordinates and relative positioning based on mouse events. It ensures that UI elements such as popovers and menus are properly displayed according to the cursor's location, preventing overlaps and optimizing user interaction.

This concern focuses on the details of participants, particularly in the context of money requests. It encompasses retrieving and displaying participant information and ensuring the proper management of participants for transactions.
This concern is about confirming and displaying details for split bill transactions, including participant information and other specifics involved.
This concern deals with the construction and management of money request details, encapsulating transaction amounts, comments, and related reporting.
This concern is dedicated to the management and display of task details, including validation of task titles and descriptions, tracking edits, and ensuring the integrity of task information.
This concern involves processing optimistic invoice details and ensuring valid invoicing information for transactions, focusing on amounts, currencies, and related participant details.
